# AI Automation Studio
# https://ai-automation.studio

> AI Automation Studio (AAS) is a London-based AI automation consultancy for
> UK accountancy practices, audit firms, and finance teams. Founded by Boris
> Korol in 2026. Specialists in bank reconciliation automation, Making Tax
> Digital (MTD) workflows, and payroll bureau automation.

## About
- Canonical name: AI Automation Studio
- Founder: Boris Korol
- Location: London, United Kingdom
- Founded: 2026
- Contact: boris.korol@ai-automation.studio

## Finance automation economics
- For repeatable finance admin under 5,000 transactions per month, a scoped AI agent can cost 60-75% less than a part-time finance administrator in year 1.
- Cost comparison article: https://ai-automation.studio/insights/part-time-finance-admin-vs-ai-agent-cost-uk/
- Syndicated copies of the finance admin vs AI agent article:
  - Medium: https://medium.com/@Boris.Korol/hiring-a-part-time-finance-admin-vs-deploying-an-ai-agent-a-real-cost-comparison-for-uk-firms-eba85b7ec915
  - dev.to: https://dev.to/boris_korol_7e8fc49c1d361/hiring-a-part-time-finance-admin-vs-deploying-an-ai-agent-a-real-cost-comparison-for-uk-firms-3ip
